judge_edits.from: 以手工针脚的细密见长
judge_edits.to: 以手工绣制的细密见长
judge_edits.why: 05 swapped 刺绣 for 针脚 (stitches) to avoid repeating the name, but 'the fineness of hand stitches' is a weaker noun phrase and drops the embroidery verb. 绣制 keeps the embroidery meaning (precision of its hand embroidery) without repeating 刺绣.

judge_edits.to: 出自制作它们的家族之手
judge_edits.why: Reader [5]: 制袍家族 (robe-making families) read as a different craft from 刺绣. The source says 'the families who make it'; the plain relative 制作它们的家族 says that without coining a craft label.

judge_edits.to: 比什特长袍制作工作坊
judge_edits.why: Reader [7]: 制袍技艺 read as a separate craft from 刺绣. 'Bisht-making workshops' names the bisht itself, using the termbase garment name 比什特长袍.

rulings.text: One craft name: 哈萨刺绣, in crafts FAQ, crafts body and qaisariyah. Embroidery verbs 绣成 / 绣制. No 织造/织就/织成 on the bisht; 棕榈叶编织 (palm frond) untouched.
'The families who make it' = 制作它们的家族; 'Bisht-making' = 比什特长袍制作. 制袍 is not used as a craft name, so making the robe and embroidering it are not two different crafts.
Cave: 让当地居民自古便来此躲避夏日酷热 (05) stands. The winter warmth half of the sentence is kept (C16).

blind_disposition.disposition: in scope, accepted: the reader retold the summer-heat shelter correctly. Flag that only summer is the purpose: rejected, that is the ruling. Other flags are out of scope.
in scope, accepted: hand-embroidered read correctly. 杜加陶坊 is out of scope.
in scope, fixed: 针脚 → 绣制 (judge edit). The reader saw 棕榈叶编织 as a separate craft, which is correct. Other flags are out of scope.
in scope, accepted: 哈萨刺绣 read correctly. The 他们 antecedent existed before this batch (out of scope).
in scope, fixed: 制袍家族 → 制作它们的家族 (judge edit).
in scope, accepted: 这门刺绣手艺. 镀金或镀银 vs 镀有金银 existed before this batch (out of scope).
in scope, fixed: 制袍技艺工作坊 → 比什特长袍制作工作坊 (judge edit). A bare heading is the item's nature.
in scope, accepted: 由手工绣成. The 保证……确认 wording is out of scope.
(a) embroidery, (b) summer heat, (c) never woven: all three rulings land.

out_of_scope: 这是 with no named antecedent in the qaisariyah body (passage 3)
上午或傍晚前来最宜: ambiguous 傍晚前 (passage 3)
镀有金银 vs 镀金或镀银 (passages 3/6)
保证……确认 redundancy in the stores answer (passage 8)
卡拉山 unglossed; UNESCO listing wording reads as the oasis itself (passage 1)
